design_note: Ambiguous middle. Aligned on values/timeline, BOTH high maturity & growth, but attraction is currently mild/'not yet'. Per human label: conditional leaning YES, because spark can be cultivated as depth, values, and character are seen over time. Tests whether the system treats attraction as cultivable (not a fixed input) when character is strong.
